A Good Shepherd ube halaya serving is about 134 kcal with ~27 g carbs, heavy on sugar, so a full serving would blow past the sugar limit even though you still have 1,068 kcal to spare. A small taste (about a tablespoon, ~40 kcal) fits better if you want to keep the rest of your day on track for dinner.
